Deal {{Red|+100%}} damage to {{Mt|Undead}} mobs but {{Red|1%}} to all other Mobs. |full_set_bonus_stats2 = Defense }} '''Reaper Armor''' has {{Green|2}} full set bonuses: {{AN|Enrage}} and {{AN|Trolling the Reaper}}. * {{AN|Trolling the Reaper}} increases healing from the {{Item|Wand of Healing}}, {{Item|Wand of Mending}}, {{Item|Wand of Restoration}}, and the{{Item|Wand of Atonement}} by {{Green|50%}}. Additionally, it grants {{Stat|def|+100}} against {{mt|Undead}} mobs and increases damage dealt to {{mt|Undead}} mobs by {{Red|+100%}}. However, it sets the player's {{Stat|dmg}} against non-{{mt|Undead}} mobs to {{Red|1%}}. * {{AN|Enrage}} is an ability activated on {{Yellow|'''SNEAK'''}}. It grants {{Stat|spd|+100}}, {{Stat|dmg|+100}}, and {{Stat|str|+100}} for {{Green|6s}}. Switching to a different armor set will cancel its effects. Additionally, each piece has a {{AN|Zombie Bulwark}} full set bonus, which grants {{Stat|def}} against Zombies.
